transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you notice when you got to the machine?

transcript.speaker: Sam Patel
transcript.text: Boom sensor warning was flickering on and off. Operator said it was worse with the boom up.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you check that turned out fine?

transcript.speaker: Sam Patel
transcript.text: Pulled the code history, didn't really check much else.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What actually fixed it?

transcript.speaker: Sam Patel
transcript.text: Swapped the boom position sensor. Warning cleared.

episode_card.symptom: Warning light comes and goes, worse with the boom raised

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you notice when you got to the machine?

transcript.speaker: Dale Hughes
transcript.text: Same boom sensor warning. It only shows when the boom is up, so I figured it's movement, not the sensor.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you check that turned out fine?

transcript.speaker: Dale Hughes
transcript.text: Tested the sensor, it was in spec. Connector pins were clean.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What actually fixed it?

transcript.speaker: Dale Hughes
transcript.text: Harness was rubbing through at the clamp halfway up the boom. Patched it, rerouted it, put a spacer in the clamp. On these 336s, check that clamp first.

episode_card.symptom: Intermittent boom sensor warning, worse with the boom raised
episode_card.fix: Repaired chafed harness at boom clamp; rerouted and re-clamped with spacer
episode_card.suspected_cause: Wire harness rubbing against boom clamp

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you notice when you got to the machine?

transcript.speaker: Dale Hughes
transcript.text: DEF warning first thing in the morning, it was freezing out.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you check that turned out fine?

transcript.speaker: Dale Hughes
transcript.text: Checked the fluid and the heater relay, both fine.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What actually fixed it?

transcript.speaker: Dale Hughes
transcript.text: Didn't replace anything. It cleared once the truck warmed up.

episode_card.symptom: DEF warning on cold morning start
episode_card.fix: No fault found; warning cleared after warm-up

transcript.text: What did you notice when you got to the machine?

transcript.speaker: Maria Lopez
transcript.text: Warning popped up right after it came out of the wash bay.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you check that turned out fine?

transcript.speaker: Maria Lopez
transcript.text: Sensor was fine, wiring looked fine.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What actually fixed it?

transcript.text: Water in the connector. Blew it dry, greased it, reseated it. Tell the wash crew to go easy on that harness.

episode_card.fix: Dried and cleaned connector, applied dielectric grease, reseated
episode_card.suspected_cause: Water in connector from pressure washing

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you notice when you got to the machine?

transcript.speaker: Maria Lopez
transcript.text: Oil low warning on the final drive, oil all over the inside of the rim.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you check that turned out fine?

transcript.speaker: Maria Lopez
transcript.text: Drain plug was tight, housing had no cracks.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What actually fixed it?

transcript.speaker: Maria Lopez
transcript.text: Seal was worn. Replaced the seal kit and refilled.

episode_card.symptom: Final drive oil low warning, oil residue on rim
episode_card.fix: Replaced final drive seal and refilled oil

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you notice when you got to the machine?

transcript.speaker: Sam Patel
transcript.text: Cut in the sidewall on the inside tire. Operator says they ran the haul road bend last shift.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What did you check that turned out fine?

transcript.speaker: Sam Patel
transcript.text: Rim's fine, other tires are fine.

transcript.speaker: Strata
transcript.text: What actually fixed it?

transcript.speaker: Sam Patel
transcript.text: Swapped the tire. That's not the first one from that bend, there's rock spilling off loaded trucks on the inside of the curve.

episode_card.symptom: Sidewall cut found on pre-shift inspection
episode_card.suspected_cause: Rock spill on inside of haul road bend
